settings.title: Courses that build
settings.intro: Every Lumen course is a complete project: you build something real, get feedback from instructors, and leave with work you can show. Here are a few of our most popular tracks.

features.title: Data Analysis with Python
features.text: From spreadsheets to real analysis. Clean, explore, and visualize data with Python and pandas, then build a portfolio project you can share with employers.

features.title: Product Management Essentials
features.text: Learn to discover, scope, and ship products people actually use. Practice with real case studies and leave with a product roadmap you built yourself.

features.title: UX & Product Design
features.text: Design interfaces that solve real problems. Cover research, wireframing, and prototyping in Figma, and finish with a polished case study.

features.title: Digital Marketing Foundations
features.text: Build a full-funnel marketing plan for a real brand. Learn SEO, paid channels, and analytics — and measure what actually works.

features.title: SQL for Business Analysts
features.text: Query, join, and analyze data like a pro. Move from basic SELECTs to complex business questions, with hands-on practice on real datasets.

features.title: Career & Interview Prep
features.text: A practical toolkit for the job search: resume, portfolio, and mock interviews with feedback from hiring managers.

settings.title: From signup to skill,
settings.intro: We designed the learning path around a working professional's week. No fluff, no filler — just a clear path from where you are to where you want to be.

steps.title: Pick your course
steps.text: Browse the catalog, read the syllabus, and choose a course that matches your goal. Every course lists the exact skills and project you'll build.

steps.title: Learn in short sessions
steps.text: Lessons are broken into focused 10–15 minute videos you can fit into a lunch break. Practice exercises reinforce each concept before you move on.

steps.title: Build your project
steps.text: Each course centers on a real project. Submit your work, get detailed feedback from instructors, and iterate until it's portfolio-ready.

steps.title: Graduate with proof
steps.text: Finish with a certificate, a completed project, and a skill you can demonstrate. Our career team helps you present it to employers.

settings.note: Most learners spend 3–5 hours a week and complete their course in 4–8 weeks — while keeping their full-time job.

settings.title: Invest in a skill,
settings.intro: One course, one price, lifetime access. No monthly fees, no surprise renewals — just the course and the support to finish it.

settings.title: Questions learners
settings.intro: The honest answers to the questions we hear most often before someone enrolls.

items.question: How much time do I need each week?
items.answer: Most learners spend 3–5 hours a week. Lessons are broken into 10–15 minute videos, so you can fit them into lunch breaks or evenings. Courses are designed to be completed in 4–8 weeks while working full-time.

items.question: Do I get a certificate?
items.answer: Yes. Every course includes a certificate of completion. More importantly, you finish with a real project you can show employers — that's what actually moves your career.

items.question: What if I get stuck?
items.answer: Every course has instructor support. You can ask questions in the course forum, and cohort courses include live Q&A sessions. Career Track students get priority feedback on their projects.

items.question: Is it really lifetime access?
items.answer: Yes. Once you buy a course, it's yours forever — including all future updates. No subscriptions, no renewals, no surprise fees.
